segments.text: Every time you check your phone 'real quick' in the middle of hard work, part of your attention stays stuck on it. It's called attention residue.
It's why the report that should take an hour eats your whole day. You never gave it one clean, unbroken block.
So do your single hardest task alone. Not tucked between emails, not 'while' anything. Phone in another room.
One task, start to finish, no switching. It's the least glamorous productivity tip, and the one that actually works.
